answer: Because each ocean escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the jade ledger records every share and the pearl audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 61 aliases means 61 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
